description:
The Houn Group, one of the largest illegal arms/drug trafficking companies in Asia disguised as a food company. The real successor of this group, Che-Ran, suddenly disappeared two years ago. Her husband, Kang-Woo, who had been keeping her disappearance a secret, was eventually caught by his father, the chairman of Houn Group, as the release date of the new medicine was approaching. Since the disappearance of Che-Ran, the only one in the group who could perfectly implement the medicine recipe, could cause enormous losses to the company, Kang-Woo belatedly began to track Che-Ran's traces. Soon after, Kang-Woo obtained information that Che-Ran was living in a certain 1k in Setagaya Ward, Tokyo, Japan. However, when he arrived there, Che-Ran, whom he had been desperately searching for, had already disappeared, and instead, he encountered Do-Hwa, a man who claimed to have been Che-Ran's housekeeper. 

The thrilling love story of two men who started with the strange purpose of having to meet a woman began in the rain on a hot summer day.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
